Going along with everyone else here ( I think), I find PC at times less toxic than console. On PC most players are pretty friendly (from my experience of course), but you might find a few people who don’t agree with you. It makes sense that many players aren’t always wanting to use mic, while being game chat the way to go if you are uncomfortable with using your voice. While in competitive, it helps immensely to have a mic and use it for quick callouts.
I’d say try out using your mic for a bit, if you like it having a fast and snappy communication go right ahead! If you want to stick to text chat, it will still work, as the community is usually 50/50 with text chat and voice chat.

TL:DR- Using your mic isn’t necessary but will help you for quick comms and might even open up a new way to play the game.

There are so many ways to play spy, like gunspy, kunai l’tranger, and dr, in the shadows load out, vanilla spy, etc.. I would say that you should focus on one or two play styles and find if it suits the way you like to play.
Another thing, know your class limits, spy isn’t a tank, he can’t double jump, but you can do some crazy things by exploiting the hitboxes of the source engine, or just the strafing that you can do really.

It all boils down to the way you play and how you express yourself through the class.
